name: Daytona Sandown Park, Esher
summary: Race go-karts on Daytona's outdoor circuit within the Sandown Park complex: a 900-metre Grand Prix circuit with eight corners and two high-speed straights, plus two shorter circuits for younger drivers, and sessions from beginner practice to championships.
reasonToVisit: Outdoor go-karting on a full Grand Prix-style circuit, with shorter circuits for younger drivers
planningDetail: Advance booking recommended; minimum ages and kart types vary by session
